references.text: The harvest laws in Exodus also describe the six-year cycle for sowing and harvesting, with a focus on letting the land rest in the seventh year.
The command to work six days and rest on the seventh reflects the same principle of a six-year cycle for agricultural labor.
The Sabbath year in Deuteronomy extends the principle of the six-year cycle to also include the forgiveness of debts.
The laws concerning fruit trees and vineyards are related to instructions about pruning the vineyard and gathering the harvest.
Isaiah's parable of the vineyard uses the same agricultural terminology regarding planting and caring for a vineyard.
Proverbs refers to sowing and harvesting as an illustration of work and reward.
